10 EMA ↓ 20 EMA screener — FAQ

10-day EMA crossed below the 20-day EMA in the last 5 trading days (event detection). It scans USA stocks and currently lists 595 matching companies, refreshed every trading day.

The screen is recalculated every trading day after market close using the latest price, volume and fundamental data.
